name: Meta Gray-Scott fast gliders
description: From the glider search (#61, a mutant of the trail gliders): about a dozen elongated spots gliding at ~6 cells per 1000 steps, four times the trail gliders' speed. D_a is raised strongly in narrow imprints (Da_gain 2.7, reach 1.4) and F in narrow trails too, with F_forget on. Tint = the D_a field.
